findings.reason: The Rhesus monkey values 10 / 56 / 1.7 in note A115 repeat the meropenem body values B123:D123. They are retained as stated values and do not constitute additional experimental observations.
findings.needed_material: Record the note-to-table duplicate mapping during independent review and carry the stated-value list to preparation for confirmation.

findings.needed_material: Preserve these fields as unknown and assess their relevance during coverage review; obtain authorized source definitions if needed for an affected downstream use.

findings.reason: The page explicitly identifies in vitro renal DHP-I kinetics, not PK. Total versus unbound basis, donor health states and a conversion or physiological bridge justification are NOT_FOUND. Km and Vmax units are stated, but units for both Vmax/Km columns are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Retain the in vitro classification and unknown fields. Require source-backed compatibility definitions and recorded justification before any proposed conversion or physiological bridge.

findings.reason: Species-specific renal DHP-I parameters are available as mechanistic context. Enzyme kinetics alone cannot satisfy the translation input requirement.
findings.needed_material: Independent coverage review of the authorized translation inputs and their source-supported relationships before translation; retain this table as supporting in vitro evidence.
